simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה (H1026) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה (Bêyth hâ-ʻĂrâbâh) means Beth-ha-Arabah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 6.

definitions.full: H1026. Beth Haarabah הָֽעֲרָבָה בֵּית proper name, of a location ( place of the depression ) reckoned to Judah Josh 15:6 , 61 , to Benjamin 18:22 = הָֽעֲרָבָה 18:18 , הָֽעֲרָבָ֑תָה 18:18 ; compare also adjective, of a people הָֽעַרְבָתִי 2Sam 23:31 (perhaps read ׳בֵּיתהָֽֿע Klo compare Dr) = 1Chr 11:32 ; — site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 6160 with the article interposed; house of the Desert;
